title: Learning the Piano Late
sentences: I started learning the piano when I was forty.
My daughter had lessons, so we already had one at home.
At first my fingers were slow and stiff.
I practise for twenty minutes before dinner.
Some evenings I am too tired and I do not play.
My teacher gives me one new piece every month.
Last week I played a short song without any mistakes.
My daughter clapped and said it was not bad.
I know I will never play very well.
But it is quiet and it makes me feel calm.
